key_insight: FinSMART replaces static, human-labeled financial sentiment training with market-aligned reinforcement learning that learns sentiment signals from realized trading outcomes.
engineering_relevance: This enables adaptive, retrainable sentiment models for algorithmic trading systems that better track non-stationary market dynamics and improve risk-adjusted performance.
method: Market-aware data filtering to reduce noisy and non-stationary financial inputs
Discrete asymmetric trading reward to convert market outcomes into reinforcement learning feedback
Market-aligned retraining using newly observed articles and realized returns
evidence_signal: In experiments, FinSMART outperformed state-of-the-art baselines, improving cumulative trading returns by 220% while also boosting profitability, risk-adjusted performance, and sentiment signal quality.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and timeliness of market feedback, so the approach may be sensitive to delayed or noisy return signals in volatile markets.
paper_title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
